strategies.overview: An absurd Speed stat, ability, and typing make Zacian-C one of the premier physical threats in the Ubers metagame. After a single Swords Dance, it threatens OHKOs or 2HKOs on even the tier's premier walls like Ho-Oh, Arceus-Fairy, and Necrozma-DM while its ability Intrepid Sword is active. It outspeeds nearly the entire unboosted metagame, making it a fantastic revenge killer, late-game sweeper, and cleaner. Its Steel / Fairy typing allows it to resist Extreme Speed from Extreme Killer Arceus, pivot into Dragon-type moves from Koraidon, and resist Calm Mind-boosted attacks from Arceus-Fairy and Arceus-Flying. While it is extremely powerful, Zacian-C is reliant on its ability to give it the power needed to break through most threats, limiting its defensive utility until it is ready to wallbreak or sweep. It also struggles to raise its Speed, leaving it extremely vulnerable to being revenge killed by Choice Scarf Pokemon such as Koraidon and Kyogre.
strategies.comments:
Other Options

Thanks to its phenomenal base typing, Zacian-C can pick and choose its Tera type to best cover the needs of the team, allowing it to fill a variety of roles:

Tera Steel allows Zacian-C to muscle through its checks like Landorus-T and Necrozma-DM with pure power. This frees up move slots so it can run Substitute or Trailblaze. It also gives Behemoth Blade a high chance to OHKO opposing Zacian-C, Koraidon, and Rayquaza.

Tera Dark boosts Crunch's damage output, allowing it to OHKO Lunala through Shadow Shield and 2HKO Necrozma-DM and Skeledirge. It also grants an immunity to Psychic-type attacks, such as Photon Geyser and Psystrike, and allows Zacian-C to resist Ghost-type attacks from Lunala, Giratina-O, and Flutter Mane.

Tera Stellar allows Zacian-C to boost all its coverage with one Tera type, allowing it to break through its checks without changing its fantastic defensive profile. With the Intrepid Sword boost, Tera Stellar Behemoth Blade has a high chance of OHKOing an opposing Zacian-C, Koraidon, or Rayquaza. Tera Stellar Wild Charge OHKOes defensive Kyogre. A +1 Behemoth Blade into a Tera Stellar Wild Charge has a high chance of 2HKOing Ho-Oh and guarantees the KO if the Behemoth Blade is also Tera Stellar-boosted. +3 Tera Stellar Close Combat OHKOes offensive Necrozma-DM, though dual STAB moves are typically run with Tera Stellar because they receive a larger boost.

Substitute can be run over an attacking move, sacrificing coverage for the ability to dodge status and safely set up. It is particularly efficient against Sticky Web teams that do not run Choice Scarf Ribombee. However, giving up a coverage move greatly hurts Zacian-C's ability to break through walls like Ho-Oh, requiring team support.

Checks and Counters

Landorus-T: Intimidate allows Landorus-T to negate the Intrepid Sword attack boost. It is immune to Wild Charge, resists Close Combat, and threatens Zacian-C back with a super effective Earthquake, which is guaranteed to KO after a round of Rocky Helmet chip damage.

Choice Scarf Pokemon: Zacian-C cannot boost its Speed, so Choice Scarf Koraidon outspeeds it and threatens an OHKO with Flare Blitz or Tera Fighting Low Kick. Similar to Koraidon, Choice Scarf Kyogre outspeeds and OHKOes with Water Spout, though it cannot safely switch into Zacian-C.

Necrozma-DM: Necrozma-DM resists both of Zacian-C's STAB moves, allowing it to check it. However, offensive sets are OHKOed by +3 Tera Fighting Close Combat, and defensive sets faint to a +3 Behemoth Blade into Close Combat while struggling to KO Zacian-C back. It is commonly paired with priority or another check like Gliscor to help deal with a boosted Zacian-C. Iron Defense + Stored Power sets wall all variants of Zacian-C that do not carry Sacred Sword but struggle to make progress in return.

Ho-Oh: Once Intrepid Sword has been spent, Zacian-C cannot break through Ho-Oh, allowing it to pivot in and check Zacian-C. However, Ho-Oh cannot blindly switch in while the Intrepid Sword boost is active due to the threat of Wild Charge.

Dondozo: Unaware allows Dondozo to comfortably wall every Zacian-C set. However, it is too passive to fit on non-stall teams, and can easily be exploited by Zacian-C's teammates.

Skeledirge: Like Dondozo, Unaware lets Skeledirge ignore Intrepid Sword's attack boost. This allows it to comfortably switch into Zacian-C and prevent it from making any progress against bulkier teams.

Gliscor: Defensive Gliscor can use its bulk to survive any Intrepid Sword-boosted attack and threatens Zacian-C back with Earthquake.

movesets.name: Ultimutt
movesets.description:
Wild Charge allows Zacian-C to break through Flying- and Water-types that would otherwise resist its attacks, such as Ho-Oh, defensive Kyogre, and Arceus-Water. Close Combat is a strong option to damage Necrozma-DM, as it 2HKOs when boosted by Tera Fighting. It also allows Zacian-C to OHKO Arceus and Kingambit while dealing heavy damage to any Pokemon that uses Tera Fire to resist its STAB moves, notably Tera Fire Koraidon. Crunch can be run as a coverage option to damage Lunala, Skeledirge, and Necrozma-DM. Tera Flying allows Zacian-C to ignore Ground-type attacks from Landorus-T, Arceus-Ground, and Groudon, giving it a free turn to set up. Tera Electric can be used to avoid paralysis from support Arceus and boost Wild Charge damage if Zacian-C is unboosted or has lost the Intrepid Sword boost. On a set with Crunch, it can prevent Imposter Ditto from turning the tables on it. Tera Fire grants resistance to Koraidon's Flare Blitz and opposing Zacian-C's Behemoth Blade, as well as preventing burns from Sacred Fire and Will-O-Wisp.

Zacian-C's Fairy typing allows it to prevent opposing Scale Shot Koraidon from boosting its Speed, denying setup for one of the most dangerous sweepers in the metagame. Ribombee is a fantastic partner for Zacian-C, as its Sticky Web provide much-needed speed control, allowing it to outspeed opposing Choice Scarf Koraidon and Kyogre as well as preventing Speed ties in the mirror matchup. Zacian-C's main roadblocks are physical walls like Landorus-T and Necrozma-DM, so it appreciates the support of strong special threats like Kyogre, Lunala, Arceus-Flying, and Arceus-Ghost, which help break them down. Physical sweepers such as Scale Shot Koraidon, Necrozma-DM, Kingambit, and Extreme Killer Arceus benefit greatly from Zacian-C forcing foes to Terastallize and weakening enemy walls. On bulkier teams, sturdy defensive options like Ho-Oh and Arceus-Water can status opposing Pokemon, while Choice Scarf Koraidon provides additional speed control. Entry hazards from Deoxys-S, Landorus-T, Ting-Lu, and Glimmora wear down foes, allowing Zacian-C to revenge kill or sweep.

strategies.overview: Thanks to Zacian-C's high base Attack backed by Intrepid Sword, it cements itself as one of the strongest physical attackers in the metagame. Its excellent typing allows it to block Dragon-type attacks from Eternatus, Koraidon, and Miraidon; resist Extreme Speed from Arceus; and be immune to Toxic Spikes. However, Zacian-C is checked by multiple defensive Pokemon, most notably Necrozma-DM and Arceus-Ground, as they can take its attacks and force it to switch out. Furthermore, Calyrex-S is a huge threat because of its high Special Attack and Speed, being able to KO Zacian-C after minor chip damage. Choice Scarf Koraidon is also a threat, as it can OHKO Zacian-C with Flare Blitz.
strategies.comments:
Other Options

Substitute is a niche option that can take advantage of Eternatus and Pokemon Choice-locked into Dragon-type moves, allowing Zacian-C to set up without interruption. Substitute isn't the best choice for Zacian-C though, as losing important coverage moves like Wild Charge and Crunch lets it get walled by checks such as Necrozma-DM, Ho-Oh, and defensive Arceus formes. Tera Fire is a niche option that grants Zacian-C an immunity to burn from Ho-Oh and defensive Arceus formes such as Arceus-Water and Arceus-Fairy while also allowing it to resist Ho-Oh's Sacred Fire and Koraidon's Flare Blitz. However, Tera Fire makes Zacian-C weak to Stealth Rock, allowing Choice Scarf users such as Koraidon and Calyrex-S and priority users in Arceus to revenge kill it with ease. An alternate EV spread of 104 HP / 252 Atk / 152 Spe allows Zacian-C to outspeed both Koraidon and Miraidon, with the remaining EVs being put into HP, allowing it to survive an Earthquake from Necrozma-DM at -1 and making it harder for Calyrex-S to revenge kill it. However, this EV spread might struggle against opposing Zacian-C with maximum Speed and offensive Necromza-DM, so it is not always the best choice.

Checks and Counters

Necrozma-DM: Physically defensive Necrozma-DM is one of the most common checks to Zacian-C, as it resists both of Zacian-C's main STAB moves and has moves like Earthquake and Sunsteel Strike that can potentially 2HKO it back.

Revenge Killers: Calyrex-S, as well as Choice Scarf users such as Koraidon and Miraidon, are able to outspeed Zacian-C. Calyrex-S can brute force its way through Zacian-C with Astral Barrage after minor chip damage or a Close Combat Special Defense drop, Koraidon is able to OHKO Zacian-C with Flare Blitz, and Miraidon 2HKOes Zacian-C with Electro Drift.

Defensive Arceus Formes: Bulky Arceus formes such as Arceus-Water and Arceus-Ground can be a problem for Zacian-C, as they can take hits from it and reliably heal themselves with Recover while also threatening it with Judgment or Will-O-Wisp.

movesets.name: Swords Dance
movesets.description:
Play Rough OHKOes Koraidon and Miraidon and 2HKOes Ting-Lu. Alternatively, Behemoth Blade is another high damage STAB move that has 100% accuracy and can hit most Pokemon for neutral damage, such as Arceus-Ground and Eternatus, while doing super effective damage to Arceus-Fairy. Wild Charge hits Ho-Oh, Kyogre, and Arceus-Water, OHKOing or doing major damage to them after Zacian-C uses Swords Dance. Crunch and Close Combat deal with Necrozma-DM, with the former also threatening Calyrex-S and the latter hitting Ting-Lu for Behemoth Blade sets and OHKOing Arceus. Tera Dark boosts Crunch's damage to let it break through Necrozma-DM more easily and prevents Zacian-C from getting 2HKOed by Calyrex-S's Astral Barrage. Tera Fighting increases the damage of Close Combat, which lets Zacian-C OHKO defensive Arceus formes at +3.

Zacian-C struggles with Calyrex-S, which outspeeds it and threatens it with Astral Barrage, so Arceus and special walls such as Ho-Oh and Ting-Lu are needed to help check Calyrex-S. It is also weak to Choice Scarf users such as Koraidon and Calyrex-S, so it appreciates teammates that can either outspeed or outprioritize threats, such as Extreme Killer Arceus, Choice Scarf Koraidon, and Choice Scarf Calyrex-S. Bulky walls such as various Arceus formes can also help with Koraidon. Due to Necrozma-DM's high Defense stat, Zacian-C often struggles to break through it, so special attackers like Calyrex-S, Miraidon, Kyogre, and Calm Mind Arceus-Ground are good options to help deal with it. Multiple layers of Spikes significantly hinder Zacian-C's longevity, making it easier for revenge killers to KO it, so Taunt users like Deoxys-S on hyper offense and various Arceus formes can be useful to have on the team. Other good teammates include physical attackers such as Dragon Dance Arceus-Ground, Necrozma-DM, and Swords Dance Koraidon because they can help wear down the checks they share with Zacian-C, allowing them to break through walls more easily.

strategies.comments:
Speed EV Benchmarks

  • 36 Spe: This outspeeds Adamant Arceus and Sneasler.

  • 84 Spe: This outspeeds Jolly Ogerpon formes.

  • 172 Spe or 36+ Spe: This outspeeds Jolly Arceus and Sneasler.

  • 164+ Spe: This outspeeds Timid Iron Bundle.

movesets.name: Offensive
movesets.description:
• Zacian-C's stratospheric Attack stat and resistance to Extreme Speed make it a great choice for sweeping late-game.

  • Behemoth Blade: Behemoth Blade's reliability is worth it, even if the coverage isn't that useful.

  • Play Rough: Play Rough is an excellent secondary STAB attack for stabbing Dragon-types like Miraidon and Koraidon, as well as dealing huge damage to Ting-Lu.

  • Quick Attack: Quick Attack may seem weak, but picking off weakened foes, especially Focus Sash users like Chien-Pao and Ursaluna-B, is extremely valuable.

  • Close Combat: Close Combat helps with revenge killing Arceus, having an 87.5% shot of OHKOing it after Stealth Rock damage.

  • Swords Dance: While Zacian-C must sacrifice some coverage to set up, it becomes nearly impossible for opposing teams to wall outside of using Dondozo or Skeledirge, and doing this lessens the risk of wasting the one-time Attack boost from Intrepid Sword.

Other Options

  • Wild Charge: Wild Charge does decent chip damage to Dondozo, Zacian-C's archnemesis, especially with Tera Electric. The recoil can be worrying, though.

Tera Types

  • Tera Dependency - Medium: Zacian-C has an amazing typing offensively and defensively, but it is vulnerable to Choice Scarf revenge killers such as Koraidon, Chi-Yu, and Miraidon, making Terastallization a good chance to flip the situation on its head.

  • Water: Tera Water is a good shield against revenge killers that use Fire-type attacks, and it allows Tera Blast to do good damage to defensive foes that Zacian-C dislikes, such as Skeledirge and Hippowdon.

  • Ground: Tera Ground protects Zacian-C from Choice Scarf Miraidon's Electro Drift, as well as providing an awesome Tera Blast against Archaludon and Skeledirge.

  • Electric: Tera Electric gives Zacian-C the best chance of dealing serious damage to Dondozo. It won't usually 2HKO Dondozo with Tera Blast or Wild Charge, but the Tera type can be invaluable later in the game when it's cleaning up.

  • Stellar: If Zacian-C is using four attacks, Tera Stellar's one-time boost to any attack can come in handy, though it doesn't help much against revenge killers.

  • Normal: Tera Normal makes sense with Quick Attack, letting Zacian-C not only pick off weakened foes more easily but also block Calyrex-S's Astral Barrage.

movesets.name: Speed Booster
movesets.description:
• Zacian-C's blistering Speed makes it royalty among late-game sweepers, as it's especially difficult to revenge kill if it gets a Speed boost.

  • Behemoth Blade: Behemoth Blade is Zacian-C's most reliable STAB attack, making it the best choice for cleaning.

  • Play Rough: Play Rough is perfect for slicing through Dragon-types like Koraidon and Miraidon.

  • Swords Dance: Swords Dance lessens the punishment of wasting the Attack boost from Intrepid Sword by switching out, though the coverage loss can be irritating.

  • Close Combat: Close Combat scores an OHKO most of the time on maximum HP Arceus after Stealth Rock damage when Zacian-C is using a Jolly nature.

Other Options

  • Wild Charge: If Zacian-C is using Tera Electric, Wild Charge can deal over 50% to Dondozo, making the move Zacian-C's best shot at cutting through it. This will likely cause a lot of recoil damage, though, so Tera Blast Electric is still an option to consider.

Tera Types

  • Tera Dependency - Medium: Zacian-C has a fantastic typing, but it's a common target of bulky threats that can use Terastallization to win, such as Koraidon and Miraidon, so counter-Terastallization is still useful.

  • Water: Tera Water saves Zacian-C from getting roasted by Koraidon's Flare Blitz and lets it deal good damage to Skeledirge and Hippowdon with Tera Blast.

  • Ground: Tera Ground is an effective response to Miraidon's Electro Drift and offers great coverage against foes like Archaludon and Tera Fire Koraidon with Tera Blast.

  • Electric: Tera Electric's defensive benefit against Miraidon is useful, but its main purpose is letting Zacian-C do huge damage to Dondozo, which otherwise is extremely difficult to break through.

Alternate EV Spreads

  • 220 HP / 252 Atk / 36 Spe with Adamant: This bulkier spread enables Zacian-C to take advantage of its excellent typing while still outspeeding Adamant Arceus and Sneasler. The extra power also ensures Close Combat OHKOes maximum HP Arceus after Stealth Rock damage.

movesets.name: Offensive
movesets.description:
Zacian-C is a strong Restricted Pokemon in Regulation G, thanks to its superb typing as well as great Attack and Speed stats, which allow it to remove fast metagame threats such as Miraidon, Flutter Mane, and Koraidon. Play Rough threatens Koraidon and common Steel-resistant foes like Raging Bolt, Iron Hands, and Urshifu-R. Swords Dance allows Zacian-C to boost past Incineroar's Intimidate and remain a strong threat on the field. Sacred Sword can be used over either of these to threaten a 2HKO on Pokemon Zacian-C may otherwise struggle to break through, such as Incineroar and Zamazenta-C. Tera Blast can be used in conjunction with Tera Ground to also threaten Incineroar and Zamazenta-C, as well as Tera Electric Miraidon, Tera Fire Koraidon, and Gholdengo. However, Tera Blast can't break through IronPress Zamazenta-C and requires Zacian-C to commit to Terastallizaion. The defensive EVs allow Zacian-C to survive +3 Body Press from Zamazenta-C and avoid the 2HKO from Calyrex-S's Astral Barrage, while the Attack investment provides Zacian-C with the ability to 2HKO bulky Calyrex-S with Behemoth Blade after Intimidate. The Speed EVs allow Zacian-C to outspeed 135 speed foes that have a neutral nature, such as Modest Miraidon. Zacian-C may opt for 108 Attack and 164 Speed with a Jolly nature, to outspeed Base 135s with a boosting nature, like Jolly Chien-Pao. Tera Fairy sheds Zacian-C's weaknesses to Fire- and Ground-type moves such as Chi-Yu's Heat Wave and Ursaluna-B's Earth Power and greatly boosts its damage, allowing Zacian-C to OHKO Kyogre and Terastallized Miraidon. Tera Ground grants Zacian-C incredible coverage and an immunity to Miraidon's Electric-type STAB moves. Alternatively, Tera Dragon provides Zacian-C with valuable resistances to Water-, Electric-, and Fire-type moves, allowing it to take attacks from threats like Urshifu-R, Miraidon, and Chi-Yu significantly better.

Zacian-C especially struggles with Incineroar, which weakens it through Intimidate and can further cripple it with Will-O-Wisp or threaten it with Flare Blitz. Zacian-C also struggles to damage Fire- and Steel-types like Ogerpon-H, Tera Fire Calyrex-I, Gholdengo, and Zamazenta-C if not packing coverage. This makes Urshifu-R an excellent partner, as it can threaten all of Zacian-C's checks and appreciates how Zacian-C reliably removes Raging Bolt and Miraidon. Chien-Pao can use Sacred Sword to threaten Zamazenta-C and Incineroar, as well as help Zacian-C break through the above checks with Sword of Ruin. Tailwind from Pokemon like Tornadus and Whimsicott is greatly appreciated, allowing Zacian-C to maintain its Speed advantage against opposing speed control. Amooonguss can be troublesome, as it takes Zacian-C's attacks well and can slow it down with Spore. In the balance mirror matchup, the Calyrex formes can also be troublesome for Zacian-C, as they are faster in their respective forms of speed control and can output more damage than Zacian-C. Umbreon and Chi-Yu are excellent partners for this reason. Umbreon can utilize its Fake Out immunity to shut down Amoonguss and prevent Trick Room with Taunt while also doing huge damage to both Calyrex formes with Foul Play. Chi-Yu can threaten Amoonguss and the Calyrex formes with Heat Wave and Dark Pulse, respectively. The two also provide Snarl utility to further minimize the threat of Calyrex-S.

movesets.name: Bulky Attacker
movesets.description:
Set Details

  • Zacian-C has a unique niche in Regulation I thanks to its blistering Speed and excellent typing, allowing Zacian-C to threaten OHKOs on metagame staples like Miraidon, Koraidon, and Grimmsnarl.
  • Swords Dance is in Zacian-C's standard moveset, as it allows Zacian-C to boost its Attack faster than Incineroar's Intimidate would drop it and ensures Zacian-C remains a threat. Sacred Sword can be used instead to score 2HKOs on Zamazenta-C and Incineroar, which Zacian-C otherwise struggles to handle. Substitute is a good alternative, as it provides a superior matchup against Will-O-Wisp Incineroar and maintains momentum by protecting Zacian-C from being flinched by Fake Out. Thanks to Zacian-C's Speed, Substitute can also act as a secondary form of Protect and help Zacian-C scout opposing Protect and Terastallization, such as Tera Fairy Miraidon.
  • The EV spread ensures Zacian-C survives Flare Blitz from Life Orb Koraidon and Guts-boosted Headlong Rush from Ursaluna after Terastallization, as well as surviving Volt Switch from Choice Specs Miraidon and avoiding the 2HKO from Calyrex-S's Astral Barrage. The Speed investment allows Zacian-C to outspeed base 135s like Chien-Pao, Koraidon, and Miraidon. Finally, the Attack investment picks up an OHKO on Grimmsnarl behind Reflect with a Behemoth Blade.
  • Tera Fairy is an incredibly consistent Tera type, ​as it sheds Zacian-C's weaknesses and bolsters its damage output, achieving feats such as OHKOing maximum HP Miraidon with Play Rough at +0 Attack.

Teambuilding

  • Zacian-C especially struggles with Incineroar, as it can mitigate Zacian-C's damage output in various ways. Volcarona and Ogerpon-H are other problematic Pokemon, as they redirect and resist Zacian-C's STAB moves; Volcarona possesses the potential to permanently cripple Zacian-C with Flame Body, while Ogerpon-H threatens to OHKO with Tera Fire Ivy Cudgel.
  • Calyrex-S is an issue, as a lot of Zacian-C's viability comes from its Speed tier, so Calyrex-S compositions will have a much easier time supporting Calyrex-S and countering Zacian-C than vice versa. Zamazenta-C is difficult for Zacian-C without Sacred Sword, as Zamazenta-C comfortably wins one-on-one.
  • Kyogre and Urshifu-R are exceptional partners, as they blast all the Fire-types that frustrate Zacian-C. In return, Zacian-C can threaten the problematic Dragon-types like Raging Bolt, Koraidon, and Miraidon. Kyogre helps Zacian-C further by negating its weakness to Fire-type moves through setting up rain.
  • Amoonguss and Incineroar are useful partners, as they can help Zacian-C set up safely. Incineroar can greatly aid with Calyrex-S and Ogerpon-H, pressuring them with its STAB attacks and Parting Shot. Amoonguss makes Zamazenta-C far easier to take on and can shut down Incineroar that aren't holding Safety Goggles with Spore and Rage Powder.
  • Chien-Pao and Landorus form great offensive synergies with Zacian-C. Chien-Pao increases Zacian-C's damage output with Sword of Ruin and pressures Calyrex-S before it can move with Sucker Punch. With Sword of Ruin, Zacian-C can OHKO bulky Kyogre with Tera Fairy Play Rough and almost always 2HKOes Zamazenta-C at neutral Attack. Chien-Pao notably threatens Rillaboom and Amoonguss, meaning it also synergizes with other common Zacian-C partners. Landorus has more direct synergy, as it can threaten OHKOs on Incineroar, Zamazenta-C, and Ogerpon-H and provides a safer Miraidon endgame as a Ground-type. Both Pokemon help force pins on Miraidon and Raging Bolt, as Zacian-C can cover for Tera Fairy.

movesets.name: Swords Dance
movesets.description:
Zacian-C stands as one of the premier physical sweepers and Gods in the metagame, donating amazing stats all around while also leveraging those stats in tandem with its amazing typing to find opportunities to set up and sweep. With Intrepid Sword granting an immediate Attack boost upon entry, Zacian-C can threaten teams even before setting up. However, when it does find the opportunity to use Swords Dance, its Attack reaches devastating levels capable of shredding even the bulkiest of walls, allowing it to be a consistent threat throughout the game. Behemoth Blade serves as Zacian-C's most consistent STAB move, and Close Combat is an extremely strong Fighting-type option to break through Steel-types such as Iron Treads, Heatran, and Excadrill. Play Rough allows Zacian-C to hit Steel-resistant foes like Rotom-Wash and Zapdos. Alternatively, Wild Charge can be used to hit key targets such as Corviknight, Dondozo, and Ho-Oh for super effective damage, as well as Gholdengo for neutral damage. Tera Fighting synergizes perfectly with Close Combat, which becomes Zacian-C's most powerful move. On the other hand, Tera Fire provides an invaluable burn immunity, helping Zacian-C avoid burns from the likes of Ho-Oh and Skeledirge, while Tera Electric ensures Wild Charge can get the 2HKO on Dondozo and bulky Gholdengo.

Zacian-C's key characteristic is being able to donate a sky-high 138 Speed, making it an invaluable teammate for slower but potent attackers like Iron Thorns, Urshifu-S, and Hydrapple, allowing them to outspeed key threats. Zacian-C's solid defensive stats mean it can be used on both offensive and defensive team structures, being able to donate useful bulk to offensive Pokemon like Roaring Moon and Iron Moth in the Defense slot or to defensive staples such as Dondozo in the Special Defense slot. Because Zacian-C should go in the Special Attack slot, Pokemon that still appreciate the minor increase in Attack such as Hisuian Samurott and Meowscarada or ones that don't necessarily need an Attack donation to function, like Ogerpon-W and Mandibuzz, pair well with Zacian-C. Despite its overwhelming power, Zacian-C still appreciates entry hazard support to maximize its sweeping potential. Thus, hazard setters such as Clefable, Ting-Lu, and the aforementioned Hisuian Samurott are appreciated. Also, without Wild Charge, Zacian-C can struggle against physical walls like Dondozo and Skarmory, as well as just always being walled by Skeledirge, so teammates that can beat these like Gholdengo, Darkrai, and the aforementioned Ogerpon-W are welcomed.

movesets.name: Swords Dance
movesets.description:
• Zacian-C is one of the most dangerous physical threats and a source of immense offensive role compression, as it is able to serve as a cleaner, speed control, and a sweeper. Additionally, after a Swords Dance boost, it can break through some of its sturdier defensive checks such as Primal Groudon and Ho-Oh after even minor chip damage.

  • Zacian-C's defensive typing provides it with a resistance to priority from Chien-Pao, Yveltal, and Extreme Killer Arceus, which is also greatly appreciated by the hyper offensive structures on which it is a staple. Zacian-C does have a place on balance and bulky offense structures, but its flaws such as a poor stall matchup, Tera reliance, and the lack of power after switching out render it merely good as opposed to a near auto include.

  • Behemoth Blade is Zacian-C's preferred STAB option due to its higher damage, solid neutral coverage, and ability to improve its matchup agaisnt opposing Zacian-C, albeit at the cost of struggling against Ditto. It also benefits from Tera Fairy being common on Pokémon such as support Arceus formes, Eternatus, and Coil Zygarde.

  • Play Rough fits on teams weak to specific Pokemon such as Marshadow and Yveltal and enables Zacian-C to cleave through Dragon-types such as Rayquaza, Mega Salamence, and Zygarde, but it does suffer from accuracy issues. It synergizes best with Tera Blast Ground, as Zacian-C will otherwise be walled by Tera Poison Arceus formes, and the combination of moves hits nearly the entire metagame neutrally.

  • Wild Charge is Zacian-C's best coverage option for Ho-Oh. +1 Wild Charge also comes with the benefit of OHKOing wallbreaker Primal Kyogre and specially offensive Yveltal after one round of Life Orb chip damage.

  • Close Combat provides Zacian-C with solid neutral coverage against Primal Groudon and Necrozma-DM, hits Exteme Killer Arceus and Arceus-Dark super effectively, and is a solid option on any playstyle. Tera Blast Ground is also an option on hyper offense structures to plow through defensive Primal Groudon and Dragon Dance Necrozma-DM but is far more committal in both the teambuilder and in game.

  • Zacian-C's Tera type depends on its coverage option in its last moveslot. Tera Fighting Close Combat is Zacian-C’s strongest move and gives it the slight damage boost it needs to OHKO Extreme Killer Arceus without a Swords Dance boost as well as defensive Primal Groudon after Stealth Rock and a layer of Spikes. Alternatively, Tera Blast Ground Zacian-C is capable of ending games on the spot against some structures but is less consistent.

  • Zacian-C rarely has an early-game presence, as it is often reliant on the initial boost from Intrepid Sword to properly wallbreak or clean. Consequently, it must make its initial entry point count; for example, against hyper offense structures, Zacian-C finds entry points to revenge kill Extreme Killer Arceus and Primal Kyogre, while Calm Mind Arceus-Dark and Arceus-Fairy provide safe entry against balance and bulky offense structures. It can also be used aggressively with Tera to set up Swords Dance against attacks that would otherwise OHKO it such as Primal Groudons Overheat or Zygarde's Thousand Arrows.

  • Zacian-C's efficacy progressively decreases against bulkier teams; even bulky offense structures usually have the means to check it defensively with Primal Groudon and a Ground-immune check such as Ho-Oh or Giratina-O. Accordingly, Zacian-C is readily forced out, sacrificing its Attack boost. Zacian-C’s worst matchup is against stall; despite Giratina and Eternatus being unable to damage it, Dondozo walls it, and Zacian-C is reliant on a teammate to pressure it to use Tera Fairy so it can make progress with Behemoth Blade.

  • Zacian-C is a staple, if not near mandatory, on every hyper offensive archetype due to its high Speed to allow it to clean and the role compression that it provides offensively and defensively. It can prevent Extreme Killer Arceus from sweeping and resists Yveltal's STAB moves; however, it must be cautious of the niche Tera Fire Heat Wave. Due to limited defensive counterplay, Zacian-C draws in Pokemon such as Primal Groudon and Ho-Oh to wear them down for teammates such as Meteor Beam Eternatus and wallbreaker Primal Kyogre to continue the onslaught or vice versa.

  • On Sticky Web structures, Chi-Yu is an excellent teammate because it helps maintain Sticky Web with a speedy Taunt, breaks past Zacian-C's checks such as Primal Groudon and Ho-Oh with Black Hole Eclipse, and is a potent stallbreaker. In return, Zacian-C alleviates Chi-Yu's issues with offense, notably its susceptibility to Extreme Killer Arceus.

  • Ultra Necrozma fills a similar role to Chi-Yu on entry hazard stack structures. It appreciates Zacian-C breaking through Arceus-Dark and Yveltal, which would otherwise check it with ease, as well as revenge killing Extreme Killer Arceus, Marshadow, and specially offensive Yveltal. Furthermore, Pokemon such as Ho-Oh, Arceus-Fairy, and Eternatus sometimes opt for Tera Dark to check Ultra Necrozma, but in doing so, they become particularly vulnerable to Zacian-C. In return, boosted Ultra Necrozma notably plows through Primal Groudon, Ho-Oh, and Coil Zygarde for Zacian-C. However, both Pokemon struggle with the stall matchup, so some additional help is appreciated such as wallbreaker Primal Kyogre and Meteor Beam Eternatus.

  • Zacian-C is still a solid Pokemon outside of hyper offense structures, but its flaws become more apparent both in the teambuilder and in battle. For example, despite a great defensive typing, Zacian-C often struggles to find safe switch-in opportunities outside of Calm Mind Arceus formes and specially offensive Yveltal. Moreover, Zacian-C's efficacy as an offensive check to common Pokemon on Sticky Web structures such as as Extreme Killer Arceus, Chi-Yu, and Primal Kyogre is nullified until the hazard is removed.

  • Offensive Ho-Oh is an excellent partner on bulky offense structures, as its defensive profile enables Zacian-C to more precisely pick and choose its entry points. Ho-Oh's longevity and offensive pressure is appreciated against stall and bulkier structures that easily check Zacian-C. In return, Zacian-C checks offensive Pokemon capable of brute forcing past Ho-Oh such as Extreme Killer Arceus, Meteor Beam Eternatus, and wallbreaker Primal Kyogre. Furthermore, Primal Groudon is a common switch-in to Ho-Oh, so if it takes any attack or Toxic, it struggles to reliably check Zacian-C. Defensive Primal Kyogre is also an excellent teammate due its stellar matchup against stall and pressuring Zacian-C's defensive checks such as Primal Groudon, Ho-Oh, and Coil Zygarde.
